creator: Governo do Estado de São Paulo

Categories.value: April 2019 in São Paulo|Extracted images|Arnold Schwarzenegger in 2019|Brazil photographs taken on 2019-04-14|Files from Governo do Estado de São Paulo Flickr stream

ImageDescription.value: São Paulo state governor João Doria welcomed the actor and former governor of California, Arnold Schwarzenegger, to discuss sustainability and green economy actions. Schwarzenegger is the founder of the R20 - Regions of Climate Action, an environmental non-profit organization founded in September 2011. In São Paulo, it is dedicated to the development of sustainable projects and supports the Municipality of Verde Azul, of the State Secretariat for Infrastructure and Environment.
